heading.title: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters

article.title: Twelve years.
article.content:
By a Hindu governed by Mitakshara law to set aside his father’s alienation of ancestral property.
Period of limitationTwelve years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the alienee takes possession of the property.
